login.tooManyRetry: Too many attempts — try again in {{seconds}} s.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts — wait a minute and try again.
login.title: Sign in to Godmode.
login.subtitle: Your coworker is waiting.
login.description: This dashboard controls an AI coworker with access to your logins. Sign in to continue.
login.footer: Session is stored in an HttpOnly, same-site cookie. Failed attempts are rate limited.
login.noPassword: No dashboard password has been set yet. Sign in with an access token — you can set a password afterwards in Settings → Security.
login.tokenHint: Run `godmode token` on the machine running Godmode to print it.

unlock.unlockedToastDescription: Your agents can sign in again.
unlock.title: Your vault is locked.
unlock.subtitle: Unlock to get back to work.
unlock.description: Enter your Godmode password to unlock logins, 2FA codes and API keys for you and your agents.
unlock.footer: Secrets stay encrypted with AES-256-GCM until you unlock.
unlock.touchIdFailed: That fingerprint didn't match. Try again or use your password.
unlock.touchIdInvalid: The fingerprints on this Mac have changed. Unlock with your password, then turn Touch ID on again in Settings.
unlock.touchIdUnavailable: Touch ID isn't available right now. Use your password.
unlock.forgotDescription: Secrets can't be recovered — your password is the only key and it never leaves this machine. You can restore a backup (then unlock with that backup's password) or start over.
unlock.resetHint: To reset, quit Godmode and delete its data directory. This permanently removes all agents, logins and 2FA codes.

restore.restoredToastDescription: Vault restored and locked — unlock with the Godmode password of the backup.
restore.wrongPassphrase: Wrong backup password or damaged file.
restore.title: Restore a backup
restore.description: Replaces everything on this machine with the backup's contents. Afterwards, unlock with the Godmode password that was active when the backup was made.
